statusText: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. The 13:30Z US cash open produced observed one-way downside: NDX opened at its day high of 29,094.72 and traded to 28,875.97, while NQ broke the 29,116.75 pre-open floor and is holding about 32 points above its 28,948.00 low. Tail crosses just into the elevated band on that structure. Stress is elevated on the semiconductor de-rating and the 18:00Z Iran announcement, and the danger window is kept narrow at 14:00Z-15:30Z.
recommendation: Descriptive: two independent quotes corroborate the current level, NQ 28,979.75 (-1.39%) timestamped 14:19Z on Yahoo Finance and 28,990.00 timestamped 14:17Z on Investing.com, against a 28,948.00 session low. The retracement off that low is roughly 32 points against a decline of about 500 points from the 29,480.50 Globex high, and the 29,116.75 floor that had held for about six hours broke without being reclaimed. Shallow pullbacks after a failed floor are the structure that denies a mean-reversion basket its exits, which is why Tail moves above the watch band rather than remaining at the pre-open checkpoint. Working against that read: VIX at 15.93 has a day range of only 0.31 points, the 10-year yield is 3.1bp lower at 4.705%, WTI is down 2.41% at 84.97, and the Dow is up 0.30% while NDX is down 1.39%. Those are rotation signatures, not the aligned amplifier stack that accompanies an index-wide repricing, so the escalation is deliberately narrow in both level and duration.
headline: Nasdaq-100: the cash open extended one-way lower and broke the pre-open floor, so Tail crosses into the elevated band
body: The US cash open at 13:30Z resolved the checkpoint that the previous assessment left open, and it resolved to the downside. Nasdaq-100 cash opened at 29,094.72, which is also the session high, and traded down to 28,875.97 within roughly half an hour; the index was last 28,901.91 (-1.39%) at 14:03Z, about 26 points above its low. NQ futures show the same path with a wider frame: the 29,116.75 low that had capped the decline for about six hours gave way, the contract printed 28,948.00, and it was last 28,979.75 (-1.39%) at 14:19Z, roughly 32 points off the low and about 500 points below the 29,480.50 Globex high. Two independent quote sources agree on both the level and the low, so the price path is observed rather than inferred. That combination, a failed multi-hour floor followed by extension and a shallow retracement, is the specific structure that overwhelms a mean-reversion basket, and it is the reason Tail moves out of the watch band. The escalation is kept narrow because the supporting cross-asset stack is absent. VIX is 15.93 (+5.29%) inside a 15.75-16.06 range, which is a contained response to a 1.4% index decline. The 10-year yield is 4.705%, down 3.1bp, and the 2-year is 4.24%, essentially unchanged, so the bond market is bid rather than pricing a growth shock. WTI is 84.97 (-2.41%) and Brent 92.55 (-1.95%), both lower despite the Iran headlines. Dispersion inside equities is the clearest signal: the Dow is up 0.30% and the S&P 500 is down about 0.31% while the Nasdaq-100 is down 1.39%. Delayed shared context collected at 13:39Z shows the same shape, with semiconductors at -2.88% on average and every one of the seven tracked names lower, against five of eight megacaps higher. This is a semiconductor and memory de-rating rather than an index-wide liquidation. Verified reporting attributes the chip weakness to a Bloomberg report that Nvidia told large customers AI server prices would rise more than 15% on memory costs, to Samsung falling over 8% in Seoul on its shareholder return plan, and to rumours that Apple is evaluating chips from China's CXMT, alongside a Netlist patent action against Micron. The scheduled stack ahead is unchanged: the Treasury press conference on Iran measures at 18:00Z today, Fed Barkin and Case-Shiller tomorrow, Core PCE and Nvidia earnings on Wednesday, and the Jackson Hole symposium with the Warsh keynote at the end of the week. Those are scored as Stress and Confidence inputs, not as Tail inputs, until a post-event price path is actually observed. Confidence is high because the live evidence is current, corroborated across independent sources, and complete across price, volatility, rates, energy and breadth.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding clock-hours carry a published Claude assessment. Through the 23 August session Tail was pinned at 4 with the EA_ON mapping while Stress drifted from 37 to 45 in a normal mode. Tail stepped to 15 at 22:00Z as the Asian technology decline began, then settled into a 7-12 band overnight. It rose to 19 at 07:00Z with Stress at 58 as the European session priced the memory complex lower in a trend-down mode, eased back to 11-13 in a mixed mode through the European morning, and then moved to 20 at 13:00Z, the first watch-band slot of the series, when the cash open was pending and unverifiable. The series therefore shows a steady build rather than a step change, and the current hour is the first in 24 to leave the watch band.
outlookSummary: The conditional path holds the elevated band only for the current hour, keeps the top of the watch band through 15:00Z while the 14:00Z-15:30Z danger window runs, eases to the watch band at 16:00Z, and returns to the low Tail band from 17:00Z onward. That shape assumes the opening auction imbalance is absorbed and price discovery turns two-sided; an unretraced break of the 28,948.00 low would invalidate it. Conditional Stress stays elevated across the remaining US session and peaks again at 60 during the 18:00Z Treasury press conference on Iran measures, which is scored as a Stress and Confidence event rather than a Tail event because no post-event path has been observed. Overnight the conditional series returns to a 9-11 Tail baseline, lifting slightly at the Tokyo and Seoul open where the memory read-across lands and again at the European open, then rising toward 17 in the hour running into the next 13:30Z US cash open. Confidence decays gradually from 84 to 72 across the horizon, reflecting distance from the current verified evidence rather than any expected deterioration in conditions.
